[GOOS:windows] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'
[GOOS:plan9] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'
[!symlink] skip 'symlink unavailable'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd fix

# --fix writes no file outside the main module. The overlay replaces a
# package file with one outside the module, and a link in the module
# points outside it. Both stalls are reported, and the logical file, the
# replacement and the link target keep their bytes.
cp ovl/main.lgo $WORK/ovl.orig
cp ../outside/main.lgo $WORK/outside.orig
cp ../outside/link.lgo $WORK/link.orig
symlink link/main.lgo -> ../../outside/link.lgo
! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 --fix -overlay=overlay.json ./ovl ./link
stderr '\[conc::group_child_stalled\]'
stderr 'logos conc: cannot fix .*outside[/\\]main\.lgo: outside the main module'
stderr 'logos conc: cannot fix .*link[/\\]main\.lgo: outside the main module'
! stderr 'logos conc: fixed'
cmp ovl/main.lgo $WORK/ovl.orig
cmp ../outside/main.lgo $WORK/outside.orig
cmp ../outside/link.lgo $WORK/link.orig

# A file that changed after the run started is refused: the finding names
# a line of the bytes the run compiled. The test of this package appends
# to its own source after the build.
! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 --fix ./stale
stdout '^ok '
stderr 'stale[/\\]main\.lgo:17: \[conc::group_child_stalled\]'
stderr 'logos conc: cannot fix .*stale[/\\]main\.lgo: changed during the run'
! stderr 'logos conc: fixed'
cmp stale/main.lgo want/stale.txt

# A receive whose rewrite the fix cannot prove keeps its hint, and no file
# changes. In rebound the context gets a new value before the wait, so a
# select on it does not end with the group. In split the receive is an
# argument of a call that starts on the line above.
cp rebound/main.lgo $WORK/rebound.orig
cp split/main.lgo $WORK/split.orig
! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 --fix ./rebound ./split
stderr 'rebound[/\\]main\.lgo:18: \[conc::group_child_stalled\]'
stderr 'split[/\\]main\.lgo:18: \[conc::group_child_stalled\]'
stderr '^\tfix: '
! stderr 'logos conc: (fixed|cannot fix)'
cmp rebound/main.lgo $WORK/rebound.orig
cmp split/main.lgo $WORK/split.orig

# Two findings in one file land in one write, latest line first. Package b
# reaches the same file through a link, so the run reports each line two
# times; the fix writes each line one time.
symlink b/main.lgo -> ../a/main.lgo
! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 --fix ./a ./b
stderr 'logos conc: fixed .*a[/\\]main\.lgo:24'
stderr 'logos conc: fixed .*a[/\\]main\.lgo:17'
! stderr 'logos conc: fixed .*b[/\\]main\.lgo'
! stderr 'logos conc: cannot fix'
cmp a/main.lgo want/twice.txt
logos build ./a ./b

-- fix/go.mod --
module example.com/concrefuse

go 1.27
-- fix/overlay.json --
{
	"Replace": {
		"ovl/main.lgo": "../outside/main.lgo"
	}
}
-- fix/ovl/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func fail() error {
	return errors.New("first job failed")
}

func slow(ctx context.Context) error {
	inner, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 1500*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	select {
	case <-inner.Done():
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return ctx.Err()
	}
	return nil
}

func jobs(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go fail()
		go slow(ctx)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("jobs done:", jobs(context.Background()))
}
-- fix/ovl/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestJobs(t *testing.T) {
	if err := jobs(t.Context()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("the first job did not fail the group")
	}
}
-- outside/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func fail() error {
	return errors.New("first job failed")
}

func slow(ctx context.Context) error {
	inner, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 1500*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	<-inner.Done()
	return nil
}

func jobs(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go fail()
		go slow(ctx)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("jobs done:", jobs(context.Background()))
}

package main

import (

	return errors.New("first job failed")

-- fix/stale/main_test.lgo --
package main

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestJobs(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile("main.lgo")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("main.lgo", append(data, "\n// edited while the test ran\n"...), 0o666); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := jobs(t.Context()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("the first job did not fail the group")
	}
}
-- fix/rebound/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func fail() error {
	return errors.New("first job failed")
}

func slow(ctx context.Context) error {
	ctx = context.WithoutCancel(ctx)
	inner, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 1500*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	<-inner.Done()
	return nil
}

func jobs(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go fail()
		go slow(ctx)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("jobs done:", jobs(context.Background()))
}
-- fix/rebound/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestJobs(t *testing.T) {
	if err := jobs(t.Context()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("the first job did not fail the group")
	}
}
-- fix/split/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func fail() error {
	return errors.New("first job failed")
}

func slow(ctx context.Context) error {
	inner, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 1500*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	keep(
		<-inner.Done(),
	)
	return nil
}

func keep(struct{}) {}

func jobs(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go fail()
		go slow(ctx)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("jobs done:", jobs(context.Background()))
}
-- fix/split/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestJobs(t *testing.T) {
	if err := jobs(t.Context()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("the first job did not fail the group")
	}
}

// edited while the test ran
-- fix/want/twice.txt --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func fail() error {
	return errors.New("first job failed")
}

func slow(ctx context.Context) error {
	inner, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 1500*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	select {
	case <-inner.Done():
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return ctx.Err()
	}
	return nil
}

func slower(ctx context.Context) error {
	inner, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 1500*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	select {
	case <-inner.Done():
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return ctx.Err()
	}
	return nil
}

func jobs(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go fail()
		go slow(ctx)
		go slower(ctx)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("jobs done:", jobs(context.Background()))
}
